create_postprocessor: create a Postprocessor instance with normalization parameters and GPU flag to invert normalized actions
run_postprocessor_forward: run the Postprocessor forward pass to unnormalize continuous action tensors back to original scale
build_postprocessor_continuous: build a Postprocessor for CONTINUOUS_ACTION type that computes min values and scaling factors from normalization parameters
test_postprocessor_input_prototype: test the Postprocessor input_prototype method to get a random tensor matching expected output feature dimensions
review_postprocessor_initialization: review the Postprocessor __init__ to understand how it validates feature types and sets up device tensors
